name: apex-dev
description: Apex AI - a friendly agentic coding assistant for the terminal

scripts.build: bun scripts/build-entry.mjs && NODE_ENV=production bun build entry.mjs --target=bun --outfile=dist/index.js --packages=external
scripts.lint: find cli.js apex.mjs entry.mjs src scripts tests -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && bun build index.jsx --target=bun --outfile=/tmp/apex-dev-lint-check.js --packages=external >/dev/null && rm -f /tmp/apex-dev-lint-check.js
